comparison.objective: Join an open drive chain and slide a forked keeper under two pin heads; candidate replaces a harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Aligning chain ends over pins and transverse keeper insertion versus connector latch release, axial extraction/mating, and cable/seal management.
comparison.success_condition: PR measures pin/hole alignment, slot retention, cradle pose, release, stability, and containment; candidate lacks corresponding connector geometry and thresholds.
comparison.reason: Both include retention, but the PR tests multi-part chain-joint assembly rather than a plug-and-receptacle replacement.
